items.name: LT Power Cable – XLPE Insulated
items.summary: Crosslinked Polyethylene (XLPE) insulated, thermoplastic sheathed LT power cable for voltages up to and including 1100 V.
items.description: LT power cable, crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated and thermoplastic sheathed, for working voltages up to and including 1100 V, used in low-voltage and medium-voltage grids for commercial, industrial, residential and infrastructure projects.
features: Preferred due to superior moisture resistance
Reduces energy waste during high-voltage transmission
applications: Low-voltage and medium-voltage grids for commercial buildings, industrial complexes, residential developments and infrastructure projects

items.name: LT Power Cable – PVC Insulated
items.summary: PVC insulated, PVC sheathed LT power cable for working voltages up to and including 1100 V.
items.description: LT power cable, PVC insulated and PVC sheathed, for working voltages up to and including 1100 V, used for internal house wiring and general power distribution in offices, malls and public complexes.
applications: Internal house wiring, lighting circuits, ceiling fans, plug sockets and household appliances
Offices, malls and public complexes for general power distribution, HVAC equipment and lighting via conduits, shafts and cable trays

items.name: LT AB Cable
items.summary: Low Tension Aerial Bunched (AB) cable for overhead power distribution up to and including 1100 V, in villages and remote communities.
items.description: LT AB cable refers to Low Tension Aerial Bunched cable, used for low-voltage and medium-voltage overhead power distribution lines up to and including 1100 V, in villages and remote communities.
features: Reduced unauthorized tapping and power theft
applications: Low-voltage and medium-voltage overhead power distribution lines in villages and remote communities

items.name: ACSR Conductor
items.summary: Aluminium Conductor Steel Reinforced (ACSR) bare overhead conductors for power transmission and distribution lines.
items.description: ACSR (Aluminium Conductor Steel Reinforced) is an aluminium conductor for overhead transmission purposes, consisting of aluminium strands surrounding a steel core, offering excellent mechanical strength and electrical performance.
features: Can handle a fair amount of stress
applications: Widely used for overhead electrical power transmission and distribution lines

items.name: AAC Conductor
items.summary: All Aluminium Conductor (AAC) bare overhead conductor for short-span overhead power distribution.
items.description: AAC (All Aluminium Conductor) is an aluminium conductor for overhead transmission purposes, used extensively for short-span overhead electrical power distribution lines in cities and towns where pole or support spacing is close.
features: Works best for distribution lines in rural areas or temporary setups
applications: Short-span overhead electrical power distribution lines in cities and towns where pole or support spacing is close

items.name: PVC Insulated Wires & Cords
items.summary: PVC insulated, unsheathed and sheathed wires and cords with rigid or flexible copper/aluminium conductors, for rated voltages up to and including 450/750 V AC.
items.description: PVC insulated, unsheathed and sheathed wires and cords, with rigid or flexible copper or aluminium conductors, for rated voltages up to and including 450/750 V AC, designed for internal house and building wiring, light and power installations, control signals, panel wiring and flexible cords.
applications: Internal house and building wiring, light and power installations, control signals, panel wiring and flexible cords

rows.value: Up to and including 450/750 V AC
